import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] binom = new long[62][62];
    static long[][] gridA = new long[32][32];
    static long[][] gridB = new long[32][32];
    static int rows, cols, seqLen;
    static char[] rules;
    static long totalWays;
    static long smallestDelta;
    static long answerCount;
    static long[][] memo = new long[32][32];
    static List<long[]>[] storeA = new List[32];
    static List<long[]>[] storeB = new List[32];

    static void populate(int i, int j, long val, long w1, long w2, boolean flip) {
        if (i + j == seqLen) {
            storeA[i][flip ? 1 : 0].add(new long[]{val, w1});
            if (w2 != 0) {
                storeB[i][flip ? 1 : 0].add(new long[]{val, w2});
            }
            return;
        }
        populate(i+1, j, val + (!flip ? gridA[i+1][j] : 0), w1, (rules[i+j] != 'B' ? w2 : 0), flip);
        populate(i, j+1, val + (flip ? gridB[i][j+1] : 0), w1, (rules[i+j] != 'A' ? w2 : 0), flip);
    }

    static void forwardWalk(int i, int j, long cur, boolean flip) {
        if (i + j == seqLen) {
            if (storeA[i][flip ? 1 : 0].isEmpty()) return;
            List<long[]> list = storeA[i][flip ? 1 : 0];
            long target = (totalWays + 1) / 2 - cur;
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(list, new long[]{target, 0}, (a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
            if (idx < 0) idx = -idx - 1;
            
            if (idx < list.size() && list.get(idx)[1] > 0) {
                long delta = Math.abs((list.get(idx)[0] + cur) * 2 - totalWays);
                if (delta < smallestDelta) smallestDelta = delta;
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                idx--;
                if (list.get(idx)[1] > 0) {
                    long delta = Math.abs((list.get(idx)[0] + cur) * 2 - totalWays);
                    if (delta < smallestDelta) smallestDelta = delta;
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if (i > 0) forwardWalk(i-1, j, cur + (!flip ? gridA[i][j] : 0), flip);
        if (j > 0) forwardWalk(i, j-1, cur + (flip ? gridB[i][j] : 0), flip);
    }

    static void backwardWalk(int i, int j, long cur, boolean flip) {
        if (i + j == seqLen) {
            List<long[]> list = storeB[i][flip ? 1 : 0];
            long target = (totalWays + 1) / 2 - cur;
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(list, new long[]{target, 0}, (a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
            if (idx < 0) idx = -idx - 1;
            
            if (idx < list.size() && list.get(idx)[1] > 0) {
                long delta = Math.abs((list.get(idx)[0] + cur) * 2 - totalWays);
                if (delta == smallestDelta) answerCount += list.get(idx)[1];
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                idx--;
                if (list.get(idx)[1] > 0) {
                    long delta = Math.abs((list.get(idx)[0] + cur) * 2 - totalWays);
                    if (delta == smallestDelta) answerCount += list.get(idx)[1];
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if (i > 0 && rules[i+j-1] != 'B') backwardWalk(i-1, j, cur + (!flip ? gridA[i][j] : 0), flip);
        if (j > 0 && rules[i+j-1] != 'A') backwardWalk(i, j-1, cur + (flip ? gridB[i][j] : 0), flip);
    }

    static void dedup(List<long[]> v) {
        if (v.isEmpty()) return;
        v.sort((a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
        long accumulated = 0;
        List<long[]> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int k = 0; k < v.size(); k++) {
            accumulated += v.get(k)[1];
            if (k + 1 == v.size() || v.get(k)[0] != v.get(k+1)[0]) {
                out.add(new long[]{v.get(k)[0], accumulated});
                accumulated = 0;
            }
        }
        v.clear();
        v.addAll(out);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        rows = sc.nextInt();
        cols = sc.nextInt();
        rules = sc.next().toCharArray();
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; ++i) {
            binom[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                binom[i][j] = binom[i-1][j-1] + binom[i-1][j];
            }
        }
        
        seqLen = rows + cols;
        totalWays = binom[seqLen*2][rows*2];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= seqLen; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= seqLen; ++j) {
                if (i > 0) {
                    gridA[i][j] = binom[i-1][rows-1] * (binom[seqLen*2-i][rows] - binom[j][rows]);
                }
                if (j > 0) {
                    gridB[i][j] = binom[j-1][rows-1] * (binom[seqLen*2-j][rows] - binom[i][rows]);
                }
            }
        }
        
        memo[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= seqLen; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= seqLen; ++j) {
                if (i < seqLen && rules[i+j] != 'B') {
                    memo[i+1][j] += memo[i][j];
                }
                if (j < seqLen && rules[i+j] != 'A') {
                    memo[i][j+1] += memo[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
            storeA[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            storeB[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            storeA[i].add(new ArrayList<>());
            storeA[i].add(new ArrayList<>());
            storeB[i].add(new ArrayList<>());
            storeB[i].add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        
        for (int k = rows; k <= seqLen; ++k) {
            if (rules[k+rows-1] != 'B') {
                populate(rows, k, gridA[rows][k], binom[k+rows-1][rows-1], memo[rows-1][k], false);
            }
            if (rules[k+rows-1] != 'A') {
                populate(k, rows, gridB[k][rows], binom[k+rows-1][rows-1], memo[k][rows-1], true);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = rows; i <= seqLen; ++i) {
            dedup(storeA[i].get(0));
            dedup(storeA[i].get(1));
            dedup(storeB[i].get(0));
            dedup(storeB[i].get(1));
        }
        
        smallestDelta = totalWays + 1;
        forwardWalk(seqLen, seqLen, 0, false);
        forwardWalk(seqLen, seqLen, 0, true);
        backwardWalk(seqLen, seqLen, 0, false);
        backwardWalk(seqLen, seqLen, 0, true);
        
        System.out.println(answerCount);
    }
}
